title_en: The Stance of the Martyr al-Sadr (may his secret be sanctified) Regarding the Caliphate Established After the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family)
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari explores the views of the martyr Muhammad Baqir al-Sadr concerning the early caliphate established after the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
